a11y: The panel is a dialog named by its title (aria-labelledby). The trigger says whether it is expanded.
Escape closes it, as does a click outside; focus goes back to the trigger.
Tab moves from the trigger into the panel, because it sits right after the trigger in the reading order.
It isn't modal: the rest of the page still works. Use a Dialog when the user must answer first.
